mapper.delete: delete from day_snapshot where code = #{code} and as_of_day = #{asOfDay}
mapper.insert:
insert into day_snapshot (as_of_day, code, bar_day, name, open, high, low, `close`, prev_close, volume, amount, percent, in_progress, create_time) values
(#{item.asOfDay}, #{item.code}, #{item.barDay}, #{item.name}, #{item.open}, #{item.high}, #{item.low}, #{item.close}, #{item.prevClose}, #{item.volume}, #{item.amount}, #{item.percent}, #{item.inProgress,jdbcType=TINYINT}, now())
mapper.select: select as_of_day, code, bar_day, name, open, high, low, `close`, prev_close, volume, amount, percent, in_progress from day_snapshot where code = #{code} and as_of_day = #{asOfDay} order by bar_day asc
select count(*) from day_snapshot where code = #{code} and as_of_day = #{asOfDay}
